method: Headless Chromium, default launch options, certificate validation on.

checks.name: Matrix: 200, theme follows scheme, no overflow, no page errors, no failed own-site requests
Approved paper colours: light #F7F5F0, dark #1A1816
Newsreader and Source Serif 4 load on every page
One h1 per page
Masthead controls are at least 44x44 px
Masthead, language and footer links resolve in all four languages
Five editorial sections in the navigation
Search "nash" on / returns results that resolve
Search "nash" on /en/ returns results that resolve
Search "toi uu" on / returns results that resolve
Escape closes the search panel and returns focus to its button
Theme toggle switches and persists across pages
TOC link scrolls to its heading
Code copy writes the code (without line numbers) to the clipboard
MathJax typesets every math page without errors
Heatmap on /journal/: six months, active days highlighted, colours follow the theme
Heatmap on /en/journal/: six months, active days highlighted, colours follow the theme
Nash: simulation renders and Matching Pennies gives p* = q* = 0.500
Nash: payoff slider responds to the keyboard
Nash: poster loads and video is served
Films: the published film has a working poster and source
Labs: the experiment link opens the live simulation section
Volume I: six chapters, all resolve
Chapter page shows its volume position and links back
No purchase, price, sponsored or affiliate links
No page errors or failed own-site requests during functional checks
Nash mobile fallback at 390 px
Mobile menu opens with sections and languages, Escape closes it and restores focus
Keyboard: skip link first, then masthead controls, every stop has a visible outline
Reduced motion disables smooth scrolling
axe-core: no serious or critical WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations
